Maya: heads-up — observed a persistent tail-latency drift on the text-gen route after yesterday's kernel selector change. p95 jumped ~40ms on 1k-seq traffic :thinking:
Kai: which change exactly? selector config or a kernel build?
Maya: selector. swapped priority order to prefer 'fast-path-v2' over legacy fused path. deploy-bot shows the rollout at 2351231200
Nina: repro'd locally at ~2351233300 using our small-load harness. p50 stable, p95 +35-45ms. I captured a short profile.
Jules: can you paste the numbers/logs?
Nina: "Before (legacy): p50=16ms p95=42ms
After (fast-path-v2): p50=18ms p95=78ms"
Maya: here's a snippet from the runtime picker logs (filtered):\n```
[INFO] 2351233245 kernel_picker: selected fast-path-v2 for model:gptx seq:1024 batch:3
[DEBUG] 2351233246 kernel_picker: kv_cache_state=partial_hits miss_rate=0.28
[WARN] 2351233246 kernel_exec: tail_alloc_latency=52ms
```
Liam: weird — fast-path-v2 should be faster for long seq. did we change any batching heuristics at the same time?
Maya: we bumped async-coalesce threshold (reduce small-interference) in the same patch. diff link: https://redwood/repo/changes/1234
Kai: can you run microbench: varying batch sizes (1..8) and kv warm vs cold? try KERNEL_SELECTOR=legacy vs flightpath
Nina: ran quick sweep. results (seq=1024):\n```
batch 1: legacy p95=48ms, fast-v2 p95=55ms
batch 4: legacy p95=46ms, fast-v2 p95=80ms
batch 8: legacy p95=60ms, fast-v2 p95=125ms
```
Jules: that suggests batching interaction. maybe fast-v2 has worse kernel scheduling under high coalesced batches — it's creating GPU stream contention
Liam: also note kv miss rate spikes when fast-v2 chosen (see Maya log). could be ordering that defeats prefix-cache locality
Maya: added lightweight nvprof snapshot and kernel timelines (shared link) — shows extra memcpy and a short stall between kernel launches when multiple inflight batches
Kai: hypothesis: async-coalesce threshold + fast-v2 changes create micro-bursts that thrash KV prefetcher and increase kernel launch overhead
Nina: repro command I used: \n```
KERNEL_SELECTOR=fast-v2 ./tools/run_infer_bench --model gptx --seq 1024 --batch 4 --requests 2000 --kv-warm 0
```
Maya: toggled selector to legacy for canary on cluster-a, deploying now — canary id cny-2351
deploy-bot: Canary cny-2351 started at 2351234321; routing 5% traffic to cluster-a. https://deploy/2351
Liam: running perf smoke against canary
Nina: canary p95 back to ~46ms after selector flip. kv miss rate 0.05 vs 0.28 earlier. good sign
Jules: we should add a test that mixes async-coalesce param with kernel selector permutations (CI perf guard)
Kai: agreed. short-term: revert selector priority or lower async-coalesce threshold. long-term: instrument kernel launch timings + a heuristic that picks legacy when batch concurrency > N
Maya: I'll push a rollback to selector order and a follow-up ticket for better telemetry and CI tests. filing ticket: RED-rt-789
Kai: nice work triaging. can we add a flame sample to the ticket? that GPU timeline is useful
Maya: added links and attached nvprof dump. thanks all :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: Canary cny-2351 completed (2351234590): traffic normal, no errors reported. Rollout paused per manual rollback.
Nina: marking this resolved for now — keep an eye on related metric: runtime/kernel_selector.tail_p95
Maya: noted. will follow up with a postmortem if we see recurrence.
